breakdown.description: The stress expression 3PL/(4bd^2) is a four-point bending formula, not the usual three-point bending relation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification continues to use σ_f = 3PL/(4bd²) and explicitly states it 'correctly matches the test geometry' for three-point bending. The ground truth corrects this to σ_f = 3PL/(2bd²), which is the proper three-point bending formula. The agent not only failed to fix the error but reinforced it by concluding the incorrect formula is valid.
